info.title: Moodly API
info.description: Moodly backend API. Authenticate requests with an Auth0 access token.

tags.name: Entry search
tags.description: Full-text search over the authenticated user's daily entries

tags.name: Habit statistics
tags.description: Statistics for the authenticated user's habits

tags.name: CDC maintenance
tags.description: Internal operations protected by the X-Maintenance-Key header

tags.name: Habits
tags.description: Habit management for the authenticated user

tags.name: Avatar
tags.description: Avatar upload and retrieval for the authenticated user

tags.name: Daily entries
tags.description: Daily mood and habit-log entries for the authenticated user

tags.name: Statistics
tags.description: Mood and habit statistics for the authenticated user

put.description: Sets the mood in the authenticated user's entry for today.
Creates or refreshes the profile for the authenticated Auth0 user. This operation is idempotent.

post.description: Creates a signed upload payload for Cloudinary after validating the image content type and size.
Verifies the uploaded Cloudinary asset and saves it as the current user's avatar.
Rebuilds the daily-entry search index. Requires the X-Maintenance-Key header.
Replays a failed CDC delivery by ID. Requires the X-Maintenance-Key header.

get.description: Returns habits owned by the authenticated user, filtered by lifecycle status.

post.description: Creates a new habit owned by the authenticated user.
Makes an archived habit active again.
Deactivates the habit without changing historical entry logs.

patch.description: Updates the name and icon. The version prevents lost concurrent updates.

get.description: Returns a structured empty state when the authenticated user has not checked in today.

patch.description: Marks or unmarks a habit in the authenticated user's entry for today.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's habits ranked by missed completions.
Returns daily mood buckets for the current Monday-through-Sunday week in the Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh timezone. Only `period=week` is supported.
Returns the authenticated user's current avatar metadata.

delete.description: Resets the avatar to the default and deletes the previous Cloudinary asset.

get.description: Calculates the current consecutive-completion streak for one of the authenticated user's habits.
Returns the authenticated user's daily entries from `from` through `to`, inclusive. Future dates are not allowed.
Searches the authenticated user's entries by text, optionally limited to an inclusive date range.
Returns today's entry, active habits, completion ratio, current-week mood summary, and the best current streak. The response is user-specific and is not cacheable.

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes; maximum 5 MiB (5242880 bytes).

targetFrequency.description: Target completion frequency. Moodly currently supports daily habits only.

version.description: Version returned by the latest read
Version returned by the latest read

habitId.description: ID of the habit to update

done.description: Whether the habit was completed today

entry.description: The complete entry, or null when the user has not checked in today.

highlights.description: Plain-text fragments keyed only by mood.note, habits.note, or mood.tags; ranges use zero-based, end-exclusive offsets.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or the access token is invalid.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not allowed to perform this operation.

MaintenanceKeyRequired.description: A valid X-Maintenance-Key header is required.
